blocks.text: KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia — CGT Asia Limited has confirmed that only one Philippine national was on board its aircraft when it departed Sultan Abdul Aziz Shah Airport (WMSA), Subang, for Luang Prabang International Airport, Laos, on Oct 1, and that the passenger boarded without any carry-on luggage. CGT Asia chief executive officer Captain Darren Chan Chee Seng said the Learjet 55B, registered as N73GP, departed Subang at about 11:30 am local time and arrived at Luang Prabang International Airport (VLLB) at about 1:30 pm.
